scope: One ordered exploratory replacement candidate for erroneous C2-R3; v1 remains frozen. No additional candidate search within this selection if this candidate fails.
reviewer: Computational AI annotator; not human or specialist review.
independence_limits: Prior case knowledge, later-frame visual familiarity and v1 review are acknowledged. This selection used only the existing baseline image and its explicitly labeled derivatives. It is not a pristine holdout or retroactive preregistration. No new replacement-reference scores or later-frame images were viewed for selection.
coordinate_convention: Zero-based native stored pixel centers, origin upper-left, x right, y down.

candidates.description: Center of the small bright roughly rectangular roof-edge patch/cap on the lower central foreground building, immediately left of the taller gridded foreground block.
candidates.envelope_definition: Subjective baseline localization envelope in encoded pixels; not a calibrated uncertainty or confidence interval.
candidates.role_limit: Apparent neighboring-building roof-edge patch, not WTC7. Exact building, component, material point and depth are unauthenticated. The brightness may include a highlight; blur, compression, repeated rooftop texture, background inclusion and differing-depth overlap may alter apparent position or matching. Physical stationarity is an assumption, not a result.
candidates.visual_association: The proposed center falls within the visible bright patch in the native baseline crop; a separately labeled 5x nearest-neighbor crop brackets that exact source pixel without covering it. It is not the old dark-area coordinate (288,400).
candidates.selection_basis: Direct baseline appearance and explicit coordinate-marker correspondence only; no later-frame performance or new numerical gate result used.

selection_rule: Root may freeze C2-R7 only after separate baseline visual acceptance and unchanged v1 baseline gates pass at BOTH 19x19 and 27x27. No fallback candidates are proposed. If it fails, preserve this bounded failure; do not silently move the center or search further.

derivatives.transformation: Exact mode-L crop [240,270,410,440), 170x170 pixels, no resize or contrast adjustment. Derived subset, not an additional source.
Same crop converted to RGB solely for red 10-pixel grid, coordinate labels and external explanatory white area; 370x200 canvas. Overlay pixels are not historical evidence.

Mode-L crop [310,390,355,433) enlarged 5x with nearest-neighbor, converted to RGB for brackets around source pixel (333,413), then pasted into a labeled 460x255 white canvas. No contrast adjustment, interpolation of detail or inferred content; visualization only.
